po2.propose.title.text: Propose a contact for the portal
po2.propose.note.text: Only a contractor with a verified registry entry that is not restricted can be invited. The invitation does nothing until a different person approves it.
po2.propose.field.name.label: Name of the contact
po2.propose.field.email.label: E-mail address of the contact
po2.propose.field.basis.label: Proof the contact belongs to the contractor
po2.propose.field.basis.hint: An e-mail equal to the registry entry is checked by the server; the other proofs need the number of a paper the approver can look at
po2.propose.field.reference.label: Reference of the paper
po2.propose.field.reference.hint: A letter number, a record number or another reference, at least 6 characters
po2.approve.note.text: On approval the system creates a guest account bound to this contractor (not to a contract) and sends the invitation to the contact. You cannot approve a proposal you made yourself.
po2.approve.field.note.label: Note of the approver
po2.reject.note.text: The proposal is closed with the reason; it can be proposed again with other proof.
po2.revoke.title.text: Revoke an invitation or a portal access
po2.revoke.note.text: A revocation takes effect at once: the guest account ends and its grants are cancelled. The reason goes to the audit trail.

po2.error.notInvitable.text: Only a contractor with a verified entry that is not restricted can be invited.

bid34.record.note.text: The outcome enters no figure until a different person confirms it. Upheld or rejected needs a petition that was answered or passed up; withdrawn applies to a petition not yet answered or passed up.

bid34.confirm.title.text: Confirm the outcome of a petition
bid34.confirm.note.text: Once confirmed, the outcome enters the dispute figures and cannot change. You cannot confirm an outcome you recorded yourself.
bid34.return.title.text: Return the outcome of a petition
bid34.return.note.text: The outcome goes back with the reason so that the recorder can record it again correctly.
bid34.error.state.text: This outcome was already confirmed or returned, or the petition already has a live outcome.
bid34.error.notAllowed.text: The petition cannot take this outcome as it stands.
